]

# extra utf-16le variants of ascii needles
needles16 = [n.decode("ascii").encode("utf-16le") for n in NEEDLES]


def scan_bytes(data, origin):
    hits = []
    for n in NEEDLES:
        start = 0
        while True:
            i = data.find(n, start)
            if i < 0:
                break
            ctx = data[max(0, i - 80): i + len(n) + 80]
            ctx = re.sub(rb"[^\x20-\x7e]", b".", ctx)
            hits.append((origin, n.decode("ascii", "replace"), i, ctx.decode("ascii", "replace")))
            start = i + len(n)
            if start - i > 20 * len(n):
                break
    for n16, n in zip(needles16, NEEDLES):
        start = 0
        found = 0
        while found < 8:
            i = data.find(n16, start)
            if i < 0:
                break
            ctx = data[max(0, i - 80): i + len(n16) + 80]
            ctx = re.sub(rb"[^\x20-\x7e]", b".", ctx)
            hits.append((origin, n.decode("ascii", "replace") + "/u16", i, ctx.decode("ascii", "replace")))
            start = i + len(n16)
            found += 1
    return hits

    lines = []
    for name, apk in apks.items():
        print("scanning", name, apk.stat().st_size)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as z:
            names = z.namelist()
            lines.append(f"## {name} entries={len(names)}")
            interesting = [n for n in names if n.endswith((".dex", ".xml", "resources.arsc")) or "AndroidManifest" in n]
            for inner in interesting:
                data = z.read(inner)
                hits = scan_bytes(data, f"{name}:{inner}")
